name: Afrimat Limited
summary: Afrimat Limited, an open pit mining company, provides industrial minerals and construction materials in South Africa. It operates through three segments: Construction Materials, Industrial Minerals, and Bulk Commodities. The Construction Materials segment offers aggregates, readymix concrete, building lime, bricks and blocks, roadlime, and silica products, as well as clinker supplies. The Industrial Minerals segment offers agriculture and animal hygiene lime, dolomite, and metallurgical calcite and dolomite products, as well as limestone. The Bulk Commodities segment mines for iron ores. It also offers drilling and blasting, mobile crushing, screening, and bid preparation and contractual services. Afrimat Limited was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Bellville, South Africa.
